name: Auto Fishing
description: Fully automates the fishing minigame — from casting to catch — with configurable tension control and auto rod change, so you can leave it running unattended.
author: Stellar

added: The plugin's text now displays in your chosen language — English, 日本語 (Japanese), ไทย (Thai), Bahasa Indonesia, and Filipino. Set it in Stellar's Settings → Themes → Language (or leave it on "Follow game client").
